config.manual: Complete Courtyard alive: wool rings both bells to open gates, then reach the right exit. World x points right, y down; player y is feet. Solid sides block walking; tops support landing. New A jumps on ground or in coyote time; hold A for the full arc, release to shorten or rearm. New B throws forward; Up+B lobs higher. Wool can hit bells and walking goons, rebound and be recovered. Goon contact hurts; water kills. Prior controls continue during API delay. Derived forecasts approximate mechanics, not observed future events.
config.question: Separate simultaneous choices for horizontal direction, A jump control and B throw control. No deterministic route.
config.throw_prompt: Keep the wool unless a forecast supports hitting an unrung bell or living goon. After launching, let that ball’s predicted contact resolve before spending another ball on the same target.
